name: Howseen
author: howseen

sections.description:
Howseen tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI answers name your brand, and writes the articles that close the gaps. This plugin publishes those articles on your site.

Connect in one click: in Howseen, Settings > Integrations > WordPress, approve the connection on your site. Howseen then installs and pairs this plugin by itself, nothing to paste.

Or by hand:

  1. In Howseen, open Settings > Integrations > WordPress and click “Generate my token”.
  2. In WordPress, open Settings > Howseen, paste the token and click “Save and connect”.

Search engines: when you connect Bing Webmaster Tools or Google Search Console in Howseen, the plugin can print their ownership tag (msvalidate.01, google-site-verification) in the head of your pages, so the site is verified without editing your theme.

That is all: no application password, no username. Articles arrive with their title, content, meta description (Yoast, Rank Math and SEOPress receive it; otherwise the plugin prints it), FAQ structured data (FAQPage), featured image, category and author.

AI assistants: the plugin counts the visits of declared AI assistants (ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, Claude-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot…) on your pages and sends the daily totals to Howseen every hour, so you see which pages AI assistants read. Only the user agent is compared: a person’s visit is never recorded, no personal data is stored or sent.

Security: every call from Howseen is signed with your token (HMAC-SHA256, 5 minute window, single-use nonce). Howseen can create posts, update a post or page it is asked to refresh, and move to the trash only the posts it created. It acts as the author you choose, with that user’s own WordPress rights. Disconnecting or deleting the plugin stops it at once.

External services

This plugin connects to Howseen (https://app.howseen.ai), the service it publishes for. It is needed to receive your articles and to show you which AI assistants read your pages.

  • Pairing: when you save a token, the plugin sends your site address, its REST address, the plugin version and the token’s public id to https://app.howseen.ai/api/connections/wordpress/plugin.
  • AI assistants’ visits: every hour, the plugin sends the daily number of visits by declared AI assistants per page (page address, assistant name, count) to https://app.howseen.ai/api/connections/wordpress/plugin/reads. No data about people is collected or sent.
  • Calls from Howseen to your site (publishing, updates, trash, ownership tags) are signed with your token and only accepted with it.

Howseen terms of service: https://howseen.ai/terms
Howseen privacy policy: https://howseen.ai/privacy
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • WordPress.org review rules: every settings form checks its own nonce, translation domain on every string.

1.2.0

  • One click: Howseen can install and pair the plugin right after you approved the connection (administrator only).

1.1.0

  • Howseen can set the Bing (msvalidate.01) and Google (google-site-verification) ownership tags in the head of your pages, so Bing Webmaster Tools and Search Console verify the site without you touching the theme.

1.0.0

  • First version.
